messages:
sasha: quick onboard check for opt-8b-v2 — putting notes here so we can async. weights landed at s3://redwood-models/opt-8b/v2/weights.tar.gz and manifest uploaded to model-registry. can someone validate checksum + shard layout?
marie chen: I saw the manifest. checksum matches locally for the first 3 shards. i'll run a full verify now and post results.
raj patel: heads-up: tokenizer has a quirk with eos mapping on this variant (split eos into <|endoftext|> + trailing space). will add a small patch to tokenizer mapping to normalize. need to coordinate change with serving config (don't strip suffix tokens). @derek fyi for eval regressions.
derek: thanks @raj. ping me when patch is ready. also we should tighten max_tokens so continuous batching doesn't blow memory on long-context. current default is 8192, i'd propose cap 4096 for canary.
sasha: agreed on canary cap 4096. here's the config snippet i'm going to apply for the canary pool — please sanity-check:
```
continuous_batching: 
  enabled: true
  batching_window_ms: 12   # small window to favor latency
  max_batch_tokens: 65536
  max_requests_per_batch: 48
  max_tokens_per_request: 4096

caching_policy:
  prefix_kv_ttl_seconds: 3600  # 1h for common prefixes
  enabled: true
  keep_top_n_prefixes: 2500

scheduler:
  max_concurrent_shards: 6
  shard_idle_timeout_ms: 120000
  prewarm_enabled: true
  prewarm_count: 1
```
marie chen: looks reasonable. only ask is bump batching_window_ms to 15 if we see tail-latency regressions in demo traffic. otherwise LGTM.
raj patel: tokenizer patch posted in PR #4287 — it's a 2-line normalize mapping, unit tests added. @sasha can you add a quick integration check in the canary that runs the tokenization smoke?
sasha: on it. i'll add a post-deploy smoke that runs: `python -m infra.token_smoke --model=opt-8b-v2 --sample=100`. will fail the canary if token counts differ from baseline >1%.
derek: also add a guard to the cache policy: if prefix_kv_hit_rate < 5% then reduce keep_top_n_prefixes to 500 to avoid memory thrash. small adaptive rule.
sasha: added that to the rollout plan. ACLs: access to the S3 path is currently set to infra-service-role and model-registry. @raj can you confirm registry can rehydrate weights to the serving nodes?
raj patel: confirmed. registry service account has GetObject + List on that prefix. will also push the presigned URLs to rollout job.
infra-bot: CI: model-registry/opt-8b-v2 verify-shards passed (12/12). checksums OK. artifact promotion queued.
deploy-bot: Deploy job #625 queued: canary=1 pool=opt-8b-v2-canary. initiated by sasha.
marie chen: quick code-review ping @raj for the tokenizer PR — small but want to run a few more edge cases.
raj patel: responded in PR, added one more test for trailing whitespace. merging after CI green.
derek: once canary is up let's run a small eval set (100 prompts) and compare n-gram / perplexity. i'll take that.
sasha: plan: roll canary with config above, run token-smoke, run derek's eval, monitor latency and cache hit-rate for 20m. if stable, promote to 10% then 100%. I'll post results in this thread.
marie chen: thanks — will monitor shard memory and report if any OOMs.
raj patel: merged tokenizer PR, registry rehydration checked. ready for canary.
sasha: starting canary deploy now. tagging logs with tx=opt8b-v2-canary.
deploy-bot: Canary deploy started: job=625, target=opt-8b-v2-canary, started_by=sasha, ts=1865432134
infra-bot: Monitoring rule: continuous_batching_tail_latency > 500ms for 2m -> alerting to #eng-oncall.
derek: running eval now. posting quick diff when done.
sasha: thanks team. will close loop in ~30m. :thumbsup:
